{{Otheruses|Secretary}}
The '''Secretary in Charge of Scheduling''' was the title of the person in charge of booking acts for the [[Imperial Entertainers' Guild]]. In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], the position was held by [[Hokkor Long]].
